title: Experiences Grid Home
description: Immersions section with three experience cards

card1_description.default: Three days of noble silence. Guided meditation, mindful movement, and contemplative practices. Learn to hear the voice beneath the noise.

card2_description.default: Forest bathing, wild foraging, earth-based rituals. Restore your relationship with the living world. Remember that you are nature, not separate from it.

card3_description.default: Write, draw, make. Creativity flows when the mind quiets. Supported by gentle structure, ample solitude, and evening gatherings around the fire.
